newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Vanke 96 net profits rise 1.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Vanke 96 net profits rise 1.5 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.47 yuan vs 0.51 yuan
Net assets per share 4.21 yuan vs 4.10 yuan
Company name: China Vanke Co Ltd.
NOTE: The results, under Chinese accounting standards, were published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Thursday.
Net profits were 151.76 million yuan in 1996 under international standards, the report said.
Vanke had net profits of 154.53 million yuan in 1995 under international standards, a company spokeswoman said.

Vanke's board of directors proposed to make a 1.5-for-10 bonus share issue and a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 10, the report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Thursday morning and resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
